title: BuildingOS Skill Document frontmatter
description: BuildingOS unified Skill document frontmatter schema (M0 draft). Superset design: compiles to DSH (SKILL.md frontmatter + resourceBase) and Codex (SKILL.md frontmatter + openai.yaml + references/). Based on the engine research in docs/api-contract.md Appendix A.

name.description: Skill name. kebab-case, at most 64 characters (identical constraint in the DSH / Codex parsers).

description.description: Routing description. Required, non-empty, single line (required by both engine parsers).

when-to-use.description: Optional routing hint; maps to DSH whenToUse.

metadata.description: Open metadata object. The known key short-description is consumed by Codex; x-buildingos is reserved for cross-engine lossless carry (M0 settled).

ui.description: Display metadata (M0 settled, top-level block). 1:1 mapping to Codex openai.yaml interface; carried via metadata.x-buildingos.ui on DSH. The M3 UI-Skill vocabulary inherits it.

invocation.description: Unified invocation policy. compile() maps bidirectionally to DSH frontmatter and Codex openai.yaml policy.

implicit.description: Implicit invocation (running a script / reading a document triggers the skill). false → Codex policy.allow_implicit_invocation: false; DSH runtime-ignores and carries it losslessly via metadata.x-buildingos.invocation-implicit (M0 settled).

products.description: Product-gating list, mapped to Codex policy.products.

dependencies.description: Skill-level tool reference list (M0 settled layering: registration lives in configs/runtime.yaml; only references are written here). Maps to Codex openai.yaml dependencies.

value.description: Tool reference; must resolve in configs/runtime.yaml (CI check).

transport.description: Import-compatible field; omitted in canonical new documents, derived from runtime.yaml by compile.

command.description: Import-compatible field; omitted in canonical documents, derived from runtime.yaml.

url.description: Import-compatible field; omitted in canonical documents, derived from runtime.yaml.

references.description: Resources referenced from the body (bundle-relative paths or URLs). DSH resourceBase / Codex references/.

data.description: Tenant data dependencies (M0 settled: distinct from references — references = skill-owned resources, data = tenant data file paths). Not in the engine view; CI verifies path existence; dynamic context assembly uses it.
